column1: # The checks of shell/list-questions.nsh. See check-shell-log.sh.
# hii get --keyword selects here the question that it selects on Linux, by its x-UEFI-ns prompt

column3: boot1.test.log get-keyword (.responses | map(.question | {name, question_id, form_set_guid, keywords})) as $here | $here == ($linux.responses | map(.question | {name, question_id, form_set_guid, keywords})) and $here[0].keywords == [{"namespace_id": "x-UEFI-ns", "keyword": "iSCSIBootEnable"}] and ($here | length) == 1

column1: # every variable that Linux lists is listed here too, where the boot-service-only MyEfiVar,
# which Linux cannot reach (UEFI 2.10 §8.2.2), is listed besides

column3: boot1.test.log variable-list ($linux | length) > 0 and ($linux - .) == [] and ((. - $linux) | any(.name == "MyEfiVar"))
